Some things to understand about Chinese tariffs and postal subsidies if you have never cared

1053046175513882629.a: 3/ What tariffs and removing postal subsidies does is force Americans to buy from distributors with a US presence such as Alibaba. Alibaba is ultimately beholden to Chinese government. See a problem? You've inserted a middleman in the form of a foreign power into every business.

1053046177611087873.a: 5/ Vote for politicians who support free trade always. It benefits everyone to leave out politics. Make stuff locally that makes sense.
